description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Kalubowila, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 520801
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and encumbrances) in the Kalubowila area. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
